meadow_background:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original landscape backdrop for a top-down pixel-art golf game, never playable ground.
Create a polished 16:9 pixel-art panorama, intended source grid 768 by 432. Absolutely no text, no UI, no golf course, no ball, no buildings, no watermarks.
An atmospheric late-afternoon meadow valley seen from far away. Broad warm buttery-yellow sky with a few long designed golden-orange cloud bands in the upper half. Tall slim irregular evergreen silhouettes mix with broad distant copses in three receding blue-green and teal depth bands in the lower half. Dark deep-jade foreground trees frame only the two bottom corners, with restrained bright grass silhouettes at the extreme lower edge. Center stays open and quiet because an opaque top-down game board will overlay it. Strong large shapes and designed empty spaces; landscape identity comes from silhouette composition and color hierarchy.
Crafted arcade pixel artwork: crisp stepped contours, deliberate pixel clusters, controlled flat 3-to-5-tone ramps, no airbrush, no 3D, no painterly brush strokes, no photorealistic texture, no random stipple or grain. Fine detail is sparse and selective. Warm sky/cool landscape contrast; not uniformly saturated. No black outlines around clouds or distance. Original work inspired by confident 1990s arcade landscape illustration. Render at 1536x864 with every logical art pixel a crisp 2x2 block.
volcanic_background:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original landscape backdrop for a top-down pixel-art golf game, never playable ground.
Create a polished 16:9 pixel-art panorama, intended source grid 768 by 432. Absolutely no text, no UI, no golf course, no ball, no buildings, no watermarks.
An atmospheric volcanic caldera at dusk. Broad warm ochre and muted amber sky across the upper half, stylized long rust-cloud bands with a pale yellow opening offset left. Three clearly separate jagged basalt mountain silhouettes step from hazy dusty rose distance to aubergine middle ground to near charcoal foreground. One major sloped volcano crater silhouette left of center with a restrained glowing orange fissure, a taller broken basalt rock buttress at the far right. Thin visible glowing lava channels in the extreme lower corners only. A few broad geometric drifting smoke bands, calm dark valley center because an opaque top-down game board will overlay it.
Crafted arcade pixel artwork: crisp stepped contours, substantial designed shapes, controlled flat 3-to-5-tone material ramps, tiny highlights only where they establish basalt edge form. No airbrush, no 3D, no painterly strokes, no photorealistic texture, no random stipple or grain, no dense showers of embers. Depth from silhouette bands and palette shifts. Original scene composition, not recolored forest. Render at 1536x864 with every logical art pixel a crisp 2x2 block.
terrain_sheet:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production top-down pixel-art ground textures for a 2D miniature golf game.
Create one square 1024x1024 atlas divided into exactly sixteen equal 256x256 square cells, 4 columns by 4 rows, with NO gaps, NO grid lines, NO labels, NO text. Every cell is a flat top-down material filling that cell edge-to-edge, NO perspective, NO shadows outside cells, NO raised square frames. Calm broad fields with a few deliberate fine pixel clusters; not busy granular noise. Crisp pixel-art, logical tile size48x48, 3-5 tones per material. Upper-left illumination. Avoid realistic texture or pixelated photographs.
Exact cell contents from left to right:
Row1: calm moss-jade short turf; same turf slightly darker; deep cool green putting turf; same putting turf slightly darker. Turf has sparse two-tone cut grass clusters (about 6 small clusters per square) and broad solid green negative space, no individual grid edging.
Row2: deep azure pond water with sparse long pale cyan broken ripples; similar pond water different ripple positions; warm buff sand with three subtle curved wind grooves; same sand slight shape variation. Water opaque, flat, no transparent field.
Row3: calm slate-purple fine basalt floor with two selective angular crack clusters; same basalt slightly darker; darker basalt putting floor with sparse muted cracks; same darker putting floor slight variation. These are paving MATERIALS not a grid of cobblestones.
Row4: dark red-orange lava pool with a few broad glowing orange molten channels and tiny yellow hot cores; similar lava different molten channel positions; warm gray moss-edged worked-stone top surface; charcoal basalt worked-stone top surface with a restrained copper edge.
Art character: individually designed pixel clusters, tightly controlled highlights, large calm interiors. Seamless outermost bands to allow edge-to-edge assembly. No decorative icon glyphs.
object_sheet:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: six original separate game object sprites, transparent PNG sprite atlas, 3 columns by 2 rows on 1536x1024 canvas.
TRUE transparent background. Each object centered in its own equal 512x512 cell with generous transparent margins. NO panels, NO floor, NO backdrop, NO grid, NO labels, NO text, NO cast shadow outside object.
Confident crafted arcade pixel art, deliberately drawn at about 96px object resolution and enlarged in exact hard pixel blocks. Precise silhouettes, dark selective outline, material highlights from upper left, 3 to5 clear shade groups per material, detailed enough to feel illustrated but not painterly or realistic.
TOP LEFT: a substantial spherical gray stone wrecking-ball mass, roughly circular compact silhouette with eight small stone angular protrusions all contained within its circle, wrapped in a dark bronze equatorial iron band with 4 visible tiny rivets. Pale upper-left facets, deep slate-purple lower-right. No chain, no shackle, no eye, no face, no stand. Solid object filling almost entire cell.
TOP MIDDLE: matching heavy iron pendulum anchor plate with a circular bronze bearing and central pin, worn mint-gray metal with bronze rivets, broad horizontal base, clearly top-down object.
TOP RIGHT: one single vertical chunky forged iron oval chain link, highlights reveal its rounded metal thickness, central hole transparent, upper-left cream glint and dark lower-right side.
BOTTOM LEFT: lush small meadow planting cluster for outside golf course, one sculpted willow-like sapling with irregular jade foliage tiers and visible warm brown trunk, a few yellow daisies at base, not a sphere topiary, no ground patch.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: small grouping of three broken volcanic basalt columns, one tall narrow dark plum column and two shorter charcoal slabs with selective copper-hot fissure rims at base, no lava puddle.
BOTTOM RIGHT: circular yellow mechanical launch pad seen directly from above, low gold steel ring, four short radial inlaid slots, unambiguous black lightning-shaped central inlay, bright warm upper-left metal edge. Not a coin. No text.
One object in each cell, none crossing into another cell. Original practical game art. Preserve true alpha.
effects_sheet:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original crisp pixel-art animation sprite sheet for a top-down golf game.
One transparent PNG canvas1536 by1152, exactly4 equal columns and3 equal rows, twelve frames. Each cell384x384. TRUE transparent backdrop, no simulated checkerboard, no background gradients, no labels, no text, no grid. Each sprite centered identically in each cell, maximum drawing footprint280x280, plenty of space. Authored pixel-art 48x48 logical frames enlarged in hard blocks. Selective flat warm highlights and deep contrast. NO realistic smoke, NO bloom, NO airbrush.
Row1: four consecutive animation poses of a small directional golf-club impact sparkle. Left to right: compact cream contact flash; sharp warm yellow four-point spark; opening handful of thin gold/cream angular shards; tiny scattered fading shards. Dominant shape points to the right. Show distinct progression from impact to dispersal. No ball or club.
Row2: four poses of a low dusty stone-wall impact puff, left to right: compact pale sand chip cluster; small ring of angular tan/cream pebble fragments; expanding dust/chip clusters with clear transparent center; a few isolated settling specks. Pixel dust chunks, not realistic clouds. No wall.
Row3: four poses of a top-down water contact splash, left to right: small cyan ring and three drops; open crown-like circular teal/cream splash; wider thin broken cyan ripple with separate droplets; sparse fading blue ripple segments. Transparent center. No water square.
Keep every frame on its own independent transparent cell. Colors: ivory#fff0c8, ochre#d09a44, pale cyan#b5f4e7, teal#358f99 and cool dark#27434e. Original practical game art, not emoji or symbols.
